retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the Lisbon municipal election of 29 September 2013, at which António Costa was re-elected mayor. The import brought several single-municipality ballots as records of their own, alongside the national local election of the same day. The atlas has no level between the country and the place, and a municipal result with no consequence recorded here has nothing to attach to in either direction. Revisit if a mayoralty is ever written as an actor.
